verdict.rationale: ClickHouse is its own columnar SQL engine with its own dialect; the evidence pack shows no claim of wire-level or dialect compatibility with Postgres, MySQL, or SQLite — only data-ingestion ClickPipes and Cloud 'Postgres services' tooling, which is data movement, not engine compatibility. Community evidence directly contradicts any such expectation, noting ClickHouse has 'not-quite-standard SQL syntax' and limited JOIN/DELETE support compared to standard engines.
